question: Where do the overtime hours sit?
text: Read Warehouse on its own: 185,763.88 of the month's cost, an average gross pay of 3,185.17 - the lowest of any department - and 181.3 of the company's 230.6 overtime hours. Its bill is flat on last year, 46.52 more a month: it lost a person (-3,951.43) and paid the rest more (+3,997.95).

question: And a November, when the warehouse works nights?
text: Move the period to November 2025: 1,021,863.15 of cost, an average gross pay of 3,948.08, and 596.4 overtime hours against 230.6 in September 2026 - 539.9 of them the warehouse's and 56.5 Customer Support's. Against November 2024 the table catches Engineering mid-hire: 11 more people, 60,470.85 more a month, 49,810.70 of it the people and 10,660.15 the pay.
